summary: Today’s PaymentsDive recap: 8 new stories, with focus on regulation, product + fintech innovation.

articles.title: Stablecoins lose ground
articles.description: While the digital currencies have gained some acceptance, there is a growing interest by financial institutions in tokenized deposits as an alternative.

articles.title: Banks undertake stablecoin effort
articles.description: Goldman Sachs, PNC and Capital One are also among 21 financial institutions partnering on an asset expected to go to market early next year.

articles.title: ACI buys UK payments tech firm
articles.description: The deal for Cranium Ventures and its cloud-based card-payments technology aims to help ACI expand in card infrastructure.

articles.title: PayPal makes job cuts
articles.description: The digital payments pioneer turned to cutting back its workforce this week following a May plan, after reportedly bypassing a possible sale.

articles.title: How Affirm leverages 0% interest
articles.description: Inflation is prompting consumers to turn to Affirm’s zero-interest buy now, pay later loans, the company’s latest financial results suggest.

articles.title: EWA grows despite legal limbo
articles.description: Instant Financial and Clair are among the earned wage access companies expanding even as state and federal oversight evolves.

articles.title: Visa delivers 6M documents to DOJ
articles.description: The government and the card network will need to complete their pre-trial evidence work by the end of January, a magistrate ruled Friday.

articles.title: Beyond the booking: How Navan scaled global card issuing with embedded finance
articles.description: How Navan unlocked €1B+ in card volume by embedding global issuing with Adyen.
